# Inpaint-web

Inpaint-web is a free, open-source image inpainting and 4x upscaling tool. Image processing runs locally in the browser and source images are not uploaded.

## Features

- Remove unwanted image content with a brush mask.
- Compare edits with the original image.
- Undo or return to an earlier result.
- Upscale supported images by 4x.
- Download the processed image.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Antman2023/inpaint-web)
